purpose: Extend Atlas Mapper mapped-sheet records so each green-checked tile carries source-profile, terrain-family, topology, layer, collision, and compatibility data instead of only visual placement.

tileRecordFields.source_rect: Exact source rectangle the engine can draw.
tileRecordFields.semantic_role: Provider-neutral Terrain Lane or asset-role meaning.
tileRecordFields.terrain_family: Coarse family such as base_surface, water_and_shoreline, overlay_and_detail, or structural connector.
tileRecordFields.topology_role: Grammar role such as base_fill, edge_or_bank_transition, water_surface_or_channel, overlay_detail, or structural_boundary.
tileRecordFields.layer_role: Renderer/editor layer ownership such as terrain_base, terrain_transition, terrain_overlay_detail, terrain_water, or structural_or_foreground.
tileRecordFields.collision_profile: Collision default or validation requirement attached to the mapped cell.
tileRecordFields.compatibility_class: How this tile may combine with V7, seasonal sheets, water topology, overlays, or structural providers.
tileRecordFields.status: draft_mapped, learned_mapping, validated_mapping, or later published_runtime.

greenCheckPolicy.tileGreenCheck: May appear when exact source-cell metadata exists.
greenCheckPolicy.learnedCheck: Requires Learn From Scene or imported correction evidence.
greenCheckPolicy.validatedCheck: Requires handoff/export and required role metadata.
greenCheckPolicy.runtimeStar: Requires cooked runtime publication, not just mapper metadata.

nonGoals: No random visual guessing as source authority.
No automatic promotion of raw or reference assets into shipped runtime content.
